functions.name: PRICE
functions.description: Price one structure (premium in the convention's premium-ccy/style).

parameters.name: callPut
parameters.description: C for call, P for put.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

functions.name: GREEKS
functions.description: The 13-Greek vector as a vertical spill [name, value] with a convention footer.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

functions.name: SURFACE
functions.description: The marked smile for a (pair, tenor) as a delta x vol grid with an arb + convention footer.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional smile model to surface: VV, SABR, SVI, SSVI.

functions.name: MARKSURFACE
functions.description: Calibrate & mark a surface under a chosen model (VV/SABR/SVI/SSVI); spills the calibrated smile + version footer.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Smile model: VV (market hedge), SABR, SVI or SSVI.

parameters.name: rr10
parameters.description: Optional 10-delta risk reversal (with bf10 for a 5-point smile).

functions.name: RFQ
functions.description: RFQ for a structure: spill [bid, offer, quoteId, validUntil] + convention footer.

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

functions.name: SUBSCRIBE
functions.description: Stream a live two-way for a structure (multiplexed, coalesced, stale-aware).

parameters.name: notional
parameters.description: Trade notional in the base currency.

functions.name: SERIES
functions.description: Stream a live market observable trend (ATM/SPOT/RR/BF/FWD), multiplexed, coalesced, stale-aware.

parameters.name: observable
parameters.description: Observable: ATM, SPOT, RR, BF or FWD.

parameters.name: tenor
parameters.description: Pillar tenor for ATM/RR/BF/FWD, e.g. 1Y (omit for SPOT).

parameters.name: delta
parameters.description: Delta wing for RR/BF, e.g. 0.25 (omit otherwise).

functions.name: MARK
functions.description: Stage a manual vol/mark contribution (two-phase, idempotent; commits via the task pane).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional smile model the commit calibrates under: VV, SABR, SVI, SSVI.
